name: hub-runtime-state-output
goal: The Hub dev server's local Cloudflare state is a declared verification output; any other added or changed file still fails the snapshot gate

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Record 9f1794f364fb at 8f7e422 failed the snapshot gate with nine files under packages/hub/.wrangler/state/v3/{cache,d1,r2}. The Hub browser tests start vite dev; adapter-cloudflare 7.2.9 calls wrangler 4.149.0 getPlatformProxy, which keeps local D1, R2 and cache state there. No output declaration covers it; first clean run with Hub browser tests

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: bunx vitest run test/self-verify-runtime-state.test.ts (sha256 5d9882c5cd35) on harness.verify.json 45a7cd438b22: 2 failed, 2 passed. Failing: drift added the nine recorded paths where none is expected; no wrangler output is declared where exactly packages/hub/.wrangler/state/ is expected. Passing guards: eleven other files still added, changed and removed source still mutated. /tmp/hub-state-red.txt

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: One line in harness.verify.json outputs: packages/hub/.wrangler/state/ (sha256 45a7cd438b22 to e7a299a81756). No guard, .gitignore, check or record changed; the Hub and its local data are untouched

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same test file (5d9882c5cd35): 4 passed. With self-verify-config 1 and utils/snapshot-additions 3: 8 passed. test/verify-snapshot.e2e.test.ts 5 passed. tsc exit 0, eslint and prettier clean, harness audit passed, units check valid (1002 units). Full verify not run

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
